description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called PermissionsSettings for managing app permissions, including location access and various capabilities such as notifications, microphone, camera, etc. It contains subviews for location settings and permission status but no class definitions, only structs and functions.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the UI layout for PermissionsSettings view, including scroll view, VStack, and embedded views.

methods.name: requestLocationAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location permissions based on the selected mode and handles user authorization.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the process of permissions request for a specific capability and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: refreshStatusTransitions
methods.description: Refreshes permission statuses multiple times with delays to account for system updates.
